title: melbourne vlog 🇦🇺 | wedding in australia & first time driving overseas!!!
description:
ANOTHER TRAVELING VLOG IS BACK! This is officially my second time in Melbourne, and this trip was extra special because I was here to celebrate my friend’s wedding. Even though the trip was short, we still have Sydney coming up in my next vlog.

A special thank you to 1 Hotel Melbourne for accommodating me during my stay. I had such a wonderful time and can’t wait to be back!
